question: In ABC club, 88% members are men and 12% members are women. If the average age of the men is 25 years and that of the women is 50 years. then what is the average age of all the members?
solution:
**Given:**

Percentage of men in the club = 88%

Percentage of women in the club = 12%

Average age of men = 25 years

Average age of women = 50 years

**Formula Used:**

Average age of all members = (Sum of ages of all members) / (Total number of members)
